content.canonicalFunction: Describes a solar or lunar eclipse that falls on a natal point, or opposite it, as a period of symbolic emphasis for what that point and its house represent.
constraints: Counts only within about three degrees of a natal point, on either end of the eclipse's axis.
Interpreted through the natal point and its house, never on its own.
A penumbral lunar eclipse weighs less than a total, annular or partial one.
